_about: A factory run's own graph: one OTO project per run, a partition kept in full and never pruned. The Run holds the plan instance; a Build per component holds its state; an Iteration is one pass of the loop, the verdict that ended the previous attempt and the gaps the runner was sent back with. The engine writes it from the events the hooks record (`oto factory run sync`) or from `oto factory run record`; nobody edits it, no model proposes into it, and only a passed build's verdict and commit are promoted into the main graph, through its gates. A relation is {domain, range, inverse, definition}.
_summary: A factory run as facts: the plan instance, each component's build and its state, every iteration with its verdict and gaps, so a run can be replayed and only its results promoted.
name: Factory run

Run.definition: One factory run: started on a date from a plan, running until every build passed or a person took the rest over.

Build.definition: One component's build within a run: planned in its group, building while the loop runs, passed when the evaluator passed it, escalated when the iteration cap was reached without a pass, failed when a person stopped it.

Iteration.definition: One pass of the loop for a build: numbered from 1, carrying the verdict that ended the previous attempt and the gaps the runner was sent back with; pending when there was no verdict yet.

build_of.definition: The one run a build belongs to.

iteration_of.definition: The one build an iteration belongs to.

follows.definition: The iteration before this one, so the order is a fact and the run replays.

plan.definition: The plan instance the run follows, as the JSON `oto factory plan` wrote: the groups and their order.

state.definition: Running until every build passed (done) or a person took one over (escalated).

component.definition: The component of the main graph this build is of, by its id.

group.definition: The plan's group the build is in: builds of one group run in parallel.

iterations.definition: How many passes of the loop the build has taken.

commit.definition: The commit a passed build was promoted with.

number.definition: The iteration's place in the build, from 1.

verdict.definition: The evaluator's verdict that ended the previous attempt; pending when there was none.

gaps.definition: The gaps the evaluator named, one sentence each, the runner was sent back with.

at.definition: When the loop made this decision, as the hook recorded it (ISO date and time).

tests.definition: What the tests said when the evaluator judged: pass, fail, or unknown when none ran or the hook was not told. Disagreement with the verdict is a fact of the run (FR4, FR5).
